Step 2: Tried a query with the wrong field `isResolved`, got an error.
Step 3: Fixed the query, got all issues matching the title "Checkout latency spikes" — 2 issues: WEB-2 ("Checkout latency spikes on mobile") and WEB-1 ("Checkout latency spikes"). Got comments for both.
